spans.s:
अधोऽंशुक
n. (-कं)
A lower garment.
E.
अधस् beneath, and अंशुक clothes.

m. (-जः)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
अधस, अक्ष an organ of sense, and ज who is produced; being produced by, or produced to, such as have subdued or cast down their passions.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Descended, gone down.
E.
अधस् down, गत gone.

f. (-तिः)
Going downwards, lit. or fig. descent, degradation. Also अधोगमः and अधोगमनं.
E.
अधस् and गति, &c. going.

n. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Descending, going downwards.
E.
अधस्, and गामिन् who goes.

f. (-ण्टा)
A plant, (Acheranthes aspera.) See अपामार्ग.
E.
अधस्, and घटि to hurt, with अच् aff.

n. (-ङ्गं)
1 The anus.
2 Pudendum muliebre.
E.
अधस् and अङ्ग member.

f. (-का)
The uvula or soft palate.
E.
अधस् below, and जिह्वा the tongue.

mfn. (-ष्टिः-ष्टिः-ष्टि)
Downcast, one who looks down.
E.
अधस्, and दृष्टि sight.

n. (-रं)
1 The anus.
2 Pudendum muliebre.

n. (नं)
An under girth or strap.
E.
अधस्, and बन्धन binding.

n. (-वः-वा-वं)
Placed below, inferior.
E.
अधस् and भव produced.

m. (-गः)
The bottom, the lowest part.
E.
अधस्, and भाग part.

n. (-रं)
Purging.
E.
अधोभाग the lower part (of the body,) हर what affects.

n. (-नं)
The regions below the earth.
E.
अधस् beneath, and भुवन a world; the world below.

n. (-र्म्म)
The anus.
E.
अधस्, and मर्म्मम् a member.

mfn. (-खः-खा-खी-खं)
1 Down-looked, looking downwards.
2 Inverted, turned upside down.
3 Headlong.
f. (-खा)
A plant, (Premna esculenta.)
E.
अधस्, and मुख the face.

n. (-न्त्रं)
A still, or the lower of two vessels luted together for distilling, sublimation, &c.
E.
अधस्, and यन्त्र a vessel.

m. (-म्वः)
A perpendicular.
E.
अधस् below, लम्व a straight line.

m. (-कः)
The regions below the earth.
E.
अधस्, and लोक world.

n. (-नः-ना-नं)
Down-looked: see अधोमुख.

m. (-शः)
1 Bottom of a thing.
2 Pudendum muliebre.
E.
अधस्, and वश dependance.

m. (-युः)
The vital air that passes downwards.
E.
अधस्, and वायु air.

n. (-त्तं)
Discharge of blood from the anus, urethra, &c.
E.
अधम्, अस्रपित plethora.

m. (-णः)
The rider or driver of an elephant.
E.
आङ् धोर to move well, ल्युट् aff.
